categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label and modifies core wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Restricting rebroadcast to wallet-originating transactions fixes a long-standing privacy leak where attackers can link node IP addresses to wallet addresses using low-fee incoming transactions. As described in issue #3828, nodes leak network identity simply by passively running a wallet and rebroadcasting third-party payments after a timeout or restart.
